work.title: Untitled (Targets and Discs)
work.description: Large-scale collage combining compact discs, concentric-ring targets, and warplane silhouettes across a white ground divided by bold vertical black and green stripes. Red, magenta, and blue accents punctuate the composition alongside iridescent CD surfaces and a small red cross motif.
work.composition: vertical stripes dividing dense layered quadrants
keywords: mixed-media collage with compact discs and targets
